method: KEYFRAME-FIRST: refs, then a free Nano Banana still per beat, then Frames to Video on Veo 3.1 Lite from each still. Motion + sound prompts only.
cast: a son in his 30s and his mother in her 60s
setting_basis: A morning at home, then the yatra track as it really looks on an ordinary day (wide concrete walkway, steel railings, metal canopy shelters, low scrubby Trikuta hills, pilgrims walking in groups, ponies led by their registered handlers), and a blank yatra card; no deity, sanctum or temple interior is shown, and the footage makes no distance, time or rule claim of its own.
look: Soft natural light, natural colour, anamorphic 35mm lens, shallow depth of field, soft film grain, photorealistic, cinematic. Faces are never in close-up and no one looks at the camera. A phone screen is only a soft glow, never legible. No one else close to the camera. No music, no speech, no voiceover, no text, captions, logos or watermark.

refs.name: ref_son
refs.prompt: Full-length photograph of an Indian man in his mid thirties with short black hair and a light beard, wearing a navy fleece jacket over a white shirt, dark track pants and grey walking shoes, a small backpack on one shoulder, standing indoors in soft window light, three-quarter view, neutral expression, photorealistic, no text.

refs.name: ref_mother
refs.prompt: Full-length photograph of an Indian woman in her mid sixties with grey hair in a long plait, slightly stooped, wearing a pale green cotton salwar suit, a red woollen shawl around her shoulders and black walking shoes, holding a small cloth bag, standing indoors in soft window light, three-quarter view, neutral expression, photorealistic, no text.

refs.name: ref_path
refs.prompt: The pilgrim track from Katra to the Vaishno Devi Bhawan in the Trikuta hills of Jammu, India, on an ordinary busy morning in soft light: a wide concrete-paved walkway climbing gently, steel railings on the valley side, long stretches under a corrugated metal canopy on steel posts, lamp posts along the edge, a small tea stall with a plain unlettered awning; groups of pilgrims in warm shawls and woollen caps walking up and down at their own pace, a few ponies led by their handlers; low dry scrub hills with broadleaf trees falling into haze. Not a deep gorge, no waterfalls, no snow peaks, not a pine forest, not a narrow stone staircase. Photorealistic, no shrine, no text, no signboards.

refs.name: ref_handler
refs.prompt: Full-length photograph of a pony handler from the Jammu hills in his forties, lean, weathered face, short greying beard, a brown woollen cap, a worn grey jacket over a kurta, dark trousers and old sports shoes, a lead rope coiled in one hand, standing outdoors in soft morning light, three-quarter view, neutral expression, photorealistic, no text.

en: When my cousin's family got back from Vaishno Devi in June, Maa asked why we never went.
I had postponed it once for work, and now she took our stairs slowly.
Then NakshIQ laid the route out: thirteen kilometres from Katra, five to eight hours on foot.
Ponies and palkis run on the traditional route, and a helicopter covers part of it.
Every pilgrim needs the free RFID yatra card, so we collected ours in Katra first.

We went in November, a best month on its list, and Maa rode a pony while I walked.
Travel intelligence is turning a worry into a plan.
NakshIQ.
hi: जून में जब मेरे कज़िन का परिवार वैष्णो देवी से लौटा, तो माँ ने पूछा कि हम क्यों नहीं गए।
काम की वजह से मैं एक बार टाल चुका था, और अब वो घर की सीढ़ियाँ धीरे-धीरे चढ़ती थीं।
फिर NakshIQ ने पूरा रास्ता खोलकर रखा: कटरा से तेरह किलोमीटर, पैदल पाँच से आठ घंटे।
पुराने रास्ते पर घोड़े और पालकी चलते हैं, और कुछ हिस्से के लिए हेलीकॉप्टर भी है।
हर यात्री को मुफ़्त RFID यात्रा कार्ड चाहिए, तो हमने पहले कटरा में ही ले लिया।

हम नवंबर में गए, जो उसकी लिस्ट के सबसे अच्छे महीनों में है, और माँ घोड़े पर चलीं, मैं पैदल।
ट्रैवल इंटेलिजेंस है फ़िक्र को प्लान में बदलना।
NakshIQ.

shot_notes: Morning at the Katra base: a son in his 30s and his mother in her 60s stand at the start of the stone path, seen from behind.
The mother climbs the stairs at home slowly, hand on the banister, while the son watches from the foot of the stairs.
On the busy yatra track the mother rides a calm pony led by its handler while the son walks beside her, shot from the side.
Their feet on wide stone steps with a metal handrail, morning light across the path.
The two pause at a railing looking across forested hills, backs to camera.
Wide shot of the empty winding path climbing the hillside in morning light, the two small figures on it.
